messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the existing Elsewhere County walking game so NPCs sleep, eat, work, and socialize, with a way for the player to interact with them.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Preserve the existing exploration and field-note gameplay.

## Decisions
- Add an accelerated day/night cycle, daily NPC routines, a town-life roster, and proximity-based conversations.
- Residents have individual names, jobs, schedules, and persistent friendship scores.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added town-life UI styles, a roster button, a town clock area, and a resident modal in `index.html`.
- Replaced idle NPC wandering with named residents, daily activity schedules, and grid-based pathfinding in `game.js`.
- Added nearest-resident detection and a conversation function with persistent friendship scores.

### Active
- Finish wiring the simulation and UI: update clock and NPC ticks, implement roster rendering/open-close controls, and route E interactions to residents or field notes.
- Test the game in-browser and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current `game.js` and complete clock progression, day/night lighting, and the animation-loop call to `tickNpc(npc, dt, hour)`.
2. Implement `paintResidents()` and wire `townBtn`, `closeTown`, modal keyboard handling, and resident schedule/friendship display.
3. Update E-key behavior to call `talkToNpc(activeNpc)` when near a resident, otherwise record a site.
4. Run the game, verify NPC routines and controls, and address errors.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Town-life UI, clock, and resident modal markup/styles.
- `game.js`: NPC schedules, pathfinding, interactions, and animation loop.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` currently calls `paintResidents()` from `talkToNpc()` but does not yet define it; the function is expected by the modal UI work.
- The existing animation loop still calls `tickNpc(npc,dt)` and must pass the current simulation hour.

## Objective
- Extend the existing Elsewhere County walking game with residents who sleep, eat, work, and socialize, plus player conversations, while preserving exploration and field-note gameplay.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game; no clarifying questions.
- Keep exploration and field notes intact.
- Finish with a playable game and briefly note assumptions.

## Decisions
- Add an accelerated day/night cycle, daily NPC routines, a town-life roster, and proximity-based conversations.
- Residents have individual names, jobs, schedules, and persistent friendship scores.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added town clock, town-life button and modal, resident roster markup, and supporting styles in `index.html`.
- Replaced idle NPC wandering with named residents, daily schedules, pathfinding, and persistent friendship state in `game.js`.
- Added NPC proximity prompts and conversation behavior; `E` now talks to a nearby resident or records a field note.
- Added town roster rendering, modal controls, keyboard shortcuts, and day/night lighting updates.

### Active
- Validate the game’s JavaScript and browser behavior; fix any issues found.
- Verify NPC routine movement, clock progression, lighting, roster display, conversations, and field-note controls.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run a JavaScript syntax check on `game.js` and resolve any parse/runtime errors.
2. Launch the game and test the NPC schedules, clock/lighting, town modal, `E` interaction routing, and existing field-guide flow.
3. Briefly report the implementation and assumptions when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Town-life UI, clock, resident modal, and controls.
- `game.js`: NPC schedules/pathfinding, interactions, UI wiring, clock, and animation loop.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Accelerated time is set to 120 in-game seconds per real second, for a 12-minute day.
- `paintResidents()` and `tickNpc(npc, dt, hour)` were added/wired, but the game has not yet been syntax-checked or tested in-browser.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
